## Design decisions
- New package `packages/benchmark` (`@rhema/benchmark`). Depends on `@rhema/contracts` + `@rhema/db`.
  Scorer + schema code is *publishable methodology* (REQ-EVAL-18); corpus content stays in the enclave (private).
  `@rhema/evals` proper is path-resolved/private (only evals-stub here), so the public machinery lives in its own package "beside evals/".
- Migration `0013_benchmark_enclave.sql` — 8 new global (non-tenant, NOT RLS-forced) tables + a dedicated
  `rhema_benchmark` role + admission trigger. Drizzle schema `schema/benchmark.ts` + index export (schema-parity test).
- Enclave store = a logging accessor seam (like mirror ContentStore) — `readDraft` ALWAYS writes an access-log row; no unlogged path to bytes.
- `packages/measure` is a skeleton → voice band scorer consumes feature vectors + author bands as inputs (extraction is measure's future job); the meaning-diff half is fully owned here.
- Scorers are pure fns over Finding[]/gold/usage_records. Human matching itself is P0.14; scorers consume match records.

## Requirements (from §18 / REQ-EVAL)
- REQ-EVAL-1 corpus distinct from fixtures; 3 real projects = frozen dev set never in headlines; synthetic never published
- REQ-EVAL-2 per-draft contamination evidence (post-cutoff, attestation, near-dup, canary, per-wave memorization probe + exclusion)
- REQ-EVAL-3 access-logged enclave; never training/fixtures/demos/marketing; provider written verification (HUMAN row); ≥20%/yr rotation
- REQ-EVAL-4 gold set: 2 independent editors in Finding schema + material flag; senior adjudication; IAA per draft; below-floor flagged
- REQ-EVAL-5 paired per-draft; pilot variance; n ≥80% power for 10pt, floor 24
- REQ-EVAL-12 voice: measure bands + claim-inventory meaning diff (dropped Tier-1 traces to disposed finding); C-e laundered control
- REQ-EVAL-13 second-read marginal contribution = gold hits unique to origin=second_read kept at reconciliation
- REQ-EVAL-14 cost/latency join from proxy metering; recall-per-dollar
- REQ-EVAL-20 benchmark runs join to run-ledger; config-hash per run; harness beside evals/ (with P0.14)
- Also: anchoring/specificity (anchor ladder), severity-calibration kappa, recall/FP over adjudicated matches, finding-diversity (C-f)

## Acceptance criteria (all deterministic)
- [ ] AC1 enclave access: every read leaves a log row; no public/fixture path resolves enclave content
- [ ] AC2 draft missing any REQ-EVAL-2 evidence field cannot be admitted to a wave manifest
- [ ] AC3 IAA verified vs hand-computed fixture; below-floor drafts flagged for re-adjudication/drop
- [ ] AC4 scorers reproduce hand-computed values on synthetic-flaw fixture set (dev-only, never publishable)
- [ ] AC5 voice: laundered fixture doesn't move meaning diff; every dropped Tier-1 claim traces or violates
- [ ] AC6 dev-set flag: a wave report render with a dev-set draft in a headline table fails

## Cross-cutting invariants to re-check
- Corpus/gold never in training/fixtures/demos/marketing; nothing transmits to a provider until no-training verified in writing (HUMAN)
- Deterministic scorers before LLM judges (C-g) — this ticket is deterministic-only (LLM judges = P0.14)
- No superiority claim without a criterion-meeting pre-registered wave (REQ-EVAL-19)

## Out of scope (do NOT do)
- Arm runners, normalization/extraction, human matching/adjudication UI, wave orchestration, pre-registration hashing, reports (P0.14)
- Corpus commissioning, editor contracting, provider written verification (human rows)
- LLM-judge machinery (P0.14)
